info.text:
Car insurance prices rose about 64% from December 2020 to December 2025, including a 20.3% jump in 2023, the biggest since 1976, before falling 5.1% in the year to August 2026. We explain how insurance pricing works with simple pool math, why car repairs and injury claims got pricier, why disasters and reinsurance keep pushing home insurance up, what job-based health premiums really cost, and the levers people use to change their share.
